answers.core: Because it would replace the current `change_scene/to` methods.
answers.workaround:
Well, it can be worked around quite easily:
```
var menu = preload("res://Menu.tscn").instance()
menu.game = self
get_node("/root").add_child(menu)
get_tree().current_scene = menu 
get_node("/root").remove_child(self)
```
But this code is not obvious to figure out for beginners in case they want to do either 1) or 2). Also this isn't really rarely used IMO.
